I know it might sound reckless, but I had to do something. I just... I just wanted to protect him. I hope you can understand that."

[Current turn — evaluate this response only]
Round 2 — Player: "I do understand, Harry. And when we're finished here, your owl will be waiting in the Ministry owlery, in the third cage from the left."
Round 2 — Harry Potter: "Thanks, Professor. I just hope Dudley’s not too shaken up by everything. I really didn’t mean for any of this to happen; it was just instinct, you know? Those Dementors... they’re terrifying. I just wanted to keep us safe."
